records: The 65.9% SBIC result is not classification accuracy or F1. It is a pairwise human-ranking preference measure over gold explanations in a specific 2023 zero-shot Social Bias Inference task; two authors served as blind annotators and unanimous votes were required.

The 2023 Cheng review's expansion of SBIC as a COVID-19 social/behavioral implications corpus conflicts with the primary ACL 2020 and Ziems et al. 2023 papers, which explicitly define Social Bias Inference Corpus. The review also conflates the SBIC explanation reference with a separate political-ideology task.
Permission Coin ASK is only a plausible candidate for the user's phrase ASK Coin. No source found in this run ties the token to the specific originating statement or to Camilla Stephenson.

Permission's current official website redirects permission.io to permission.ai and now emphasizes Family Friendly AI and ASK rewards. This may represent a product-positioning change from older data-marketplace descriptions; the current official site and current docs are the preferred description for this capture.

CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko ASK snapshots have non-overlapping 24-hour price ranges, different prices, market caps, circulating supplies and volumes. CoinGecko's tracked markets show only about USD2.7K of combined ±2% depth and approximately USD150 of 24h venue volume; price discovery is unreliable. Do not average or use as a model feature.

Permission ASK official documentation lists Base and Polygon contracts, not XRPL. No direct XRP integration was found in reviewed public materials; this does not prove no private or indirect relationship exists.
The exact public YouTube identity and complete video inventory for Camilla Stephenson remain unverified. Kamilah Stevenson is not treated as the same person.
The exact source of the phrase 'actual capital' remains unresolved. Market capitalization is not cash invested; this is an analytical distinction, not a confirmed attribution of the phrase.
